title: ARR-1 anchor record
description: The message written to the public ledger for one batch. It carries the root and nothing about what was bought. Submitted in canonical form (see the specification).

app.description: Identifier of the issuer, e.g. x402receipts.

root.description: Merkle root of the batch's receipt fingerprints.

count.description: How many receipts are in the batch.

url.description: Optional page where the batch can be inspected.
